sys_hub_action_type_definition.description:
This action inspects a container on a Docker instance.

Inputs:

  • Container ID - The container ID which needs to be inspected.
  • Return Size - Accepts 'true' or 'false' values, if set to 'true' will return the size of container as fields 'SizeRw' and 'SizeRootFs'.

Outputs:

  • Container Details - Container details containing -
    • ID
    • Created
    • Path
    • Args
    • State
    • Image
    • Resolv Conf Path
    • Hostname Path
    • Hosts Path
    • Log Path
    • Name
    • Restart Count
    • Driver
    • Platform
    • Mount Label
    • Process Label
    • App Armor Profile
    • Exec IDs
    • Host Config
    • Graph Driver
    • Size Rw
    • Size Root Fs
    • Mounts
    • Config
    • Network Settings
  • Container Information - The details of the container in case if the request was successful.
  • Status - Will be set to "Success" if the request succeeds or "Error" if a failure occurs.
  • Error Message - Will be populated when the status is "Error".

Error Messages:

  • No such container
  • Provided container ID is invalid.

Note : User may expect additional error messages based on the API response.

To use this action, the corresponding Docker connection and credential must be created and associated with the Docker Connection & Credential alias.Learn More

Note: Requires a subscription for production use. Read More.

sys_hub_action_type_snapshot.description:
This action inspects a container on a Docker instance.

Inputs:

  • Container ID - The container ID which needs to be inspected.
  • Return Size - Accepts 'true' or 'false' values, if set to 'true' will return the size of container as fields 'SizeRw' and 'SizeRootFs'.

Outputs:

  • Container Details - Container details containing -
    • ID
    • Created
    • Path
    • Args
    • State
    • Image
    • Resolv Conf Path
    • Hostname Path
    • Hosts Path
    • Log Path
    • Name
    • Restart Count
    • Driver
    • Platform
    • Mount Label
    • Process Label
    • App Armor Profile
    • Exec IDs
    • Host Config
    • Graph Driver
    • Size Rw
    • Size Root Fs
    • Mounts
    • Config
    • Network Settings
  • Container Information - The details of the container in case if the request was successful.
  • Status - Will be set to "Success" if the request succeeds or "Error" if a failure occurs.
  • Error Message - Will be populated when the status is "Error".

Error Messages:

  • No such container
  • Provided container ID is invalid.

Note : User may expect additional error messages based on the API response.

To use this action, the corresponding Docker connection and credential must be created and associated with the Docker Connection & Credential alias.Learn More

Note: Requires a subscription for production use. Read More.
